keyPoints.en: Biology is the study of living things — their structure, function, growth, evolution and interactions.
keyPoints.bm: Biologi ialah kajian benda hidup — struktur, fungsi, pertumbuhan, evolusi dan interaksinya.

keyPoints.en: Main fields: zoology, botany, microbiology, anatomy, physiology, genetics, ecology, biochemistry, biotechnology.
keyPoints.bm: Bidang utama: zoologi, botani, mikrobiologi, anatomi, fisiologi, genetik, ekologi, biokimia, bioteknologi.

keyPoints.en: Careers: medicine, nursing, pharmacy, veterinary science, agriculture, forensics, marine biology, research.
keyPoints.bm: Kerjaya: perubatan, kejururawatan, farmasi, veterinar, pertanian, forensik, biologi marin, penyelidikan.

keyPoints.en: Biology helps solve problems: disease control (vaccines), food security (better crops), conservation of biodiversity.
keyPoints.bm: Biologi membantu menyelesaikan masalah: kawalan penyakit (vaksin), sekuriti makanan (tanaman lebih baik), pemuliharaan biodiversiti.

question.en: Name a biology career that helps solve crimes.
question.bm: Namakan kerjaya biologi yang membantu menyelesaikan jenayah.

answer.en: Forensic scientist — analyses DNA, blood and other evidence.
answer.bm: Saintis forensik — menganalisis DNA, darah dan bukti lain.

tip.en: Link each field to a real Malaysian example (MARDI, IMR, FRIM) to remember it.
tip.bm: Kaitkan setiap bidang dengan contoh sebenar di Malaysia (MARDI, IMR, FRIM) untuk mengingatinya.

keyPoints.en: Wear personal protective equipment: lab coat, gloves, goggles, face mask and closed shoes.
keyPoints.bm: Pakai peralatan pelindung diri: kot makmal, sarung tangan, gogal, topeng muka dan kasut tertutup.

keyPoints.en: Never eat, drink or taste anything in the lab; wash hands after handling specimens.
keyPoints.bm: Jangan makan, minum atau merasa apa-apa di makmal; basuh tangan selepas mengendalikan spesimen.

keyPoints.en: Handle microorganisms in a biosafety cabinet; sterilise equipment and cultures in an autoclave.
keyPoints.bm: Kendalikan mikroorganisma dalam kabinet keselamatan biologi; sterilkan peralatan dan kultur dalam autoklaf.

keyPoints.en: Dispose of waste correctly: sharps in sharps containers, biological waste sterilised first, chemicals in labelled bottles.
keyPoints.bm: Lupuskan sisa dengan betul: objek tajam dalam bekas khas, sisa biologi disterilkan dahulu, bahan kimia dalam botol berlabel.

keyPoints.en: Report every accident, spill or breakage to the teacher immediately.
keyPoints.bm: Laporkan setiap kemalangan, tumpahan atau kerosakan kepada guru dengan segera.

question.en: A student cuts a finger on a broken slide. What should be done?
question.bm: Seorang pelajar terluka jari akibat slaid pecah. Apakah yang perlu dilakukan?

answer.en: Wash the wound, apply first aid, tell the teacher, and dispose of the broken glass in the sharps/glass container.
answer.bm: Cuci luka, beri pertolongan cemas, beritahu guru, dan buang kaca pecah dalam bekas objek tajam/kaca.

tip.en: Treat all biological specimens as if they could carry disease.
tip.bm: Anggap semua spesimen biologi seolah-olah boleh membawa penyakit.

keyPoints.en: Steps: identify the problem, form a hypothesis, plan (variables, materials, procedure), experiment, collect data, analyse, conclude, report.
keyPoints.bm: Langkah: kenal pasti masalah, bina hipotesis, rancang (pemboleh ubah, bahan, prosedur), eksperimen, kumpul data, analisis, simpul, lapor.

keyPoints.en: Manipulated variable: what you change. Responding: what you measure. Constant: what you keep the same.
keyPoints.bm: Dimanipulasikan: yang diubah. Bergerak balas: yang diukur. Dimalarkan: yang ditetapkan.

keyPoints.en: A control set-up lets you compare and prove the effect is due to the manipulated variable.
keyPoints.bm: Susunan kawalan membolehkan perbandingan dan membuktikan kesan disebabkan pemboleh ubah dimanipulasikan.

keyPoints.en: Present data in tables and graphs; repeat the experiment to improve reliability.
keyPoints.bm: Bentangkan data dalam jadual dan graf; ulang eksperimen untuk meningkatkan kebolehpercayaan.

question.en: Write a hypothesis on how temperature affects enzyme activity.
question.bm: Tulis hipotesis tentang kesan suhu terhadap aktiviti enzim.

answer.en: Enzyme activity increases as temperature increases up to the optimum temperature.
answer.bm: Aktiviti enzim bertambah apabila suhu meningkat sehingga suhu optimum.

tip.en: Graph: manipulated variable on the x-axis, responding variable on the y-axis.
tip.bm: Graf: pemboleh ubah dimanipulasikan pada paksi-x, bergerak balas pada paksi-y.
